name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
title: KPIT Technologies Ltd - 542651 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 growth was only 1.8% constant currency QoQ-ish with two large SDV programs rolling off; management guides FY27 EBITDA 20.5–21.2% and medium-term 22–24%, with no supply-side capacity signal.

triggers.label: Two large SDV programs ending
triggers.quote: Two of our largest SDV programs coming to an end, but the revenue will be largely compensated by growth in newly acquired accounts.

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA 20.5–21.2%
triggers.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.

triggers.label: Solutions & products to 50% in medium term
triggers.quote: Again, go back to the old days 50% revenue share to be achieved from solutions and product.

triggers.label: Honda cancelled new platform programs
triggers.quote: Honda, they basically cancelled all their new platform programs And that had an impact on us

guidance.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.
We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products
we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.
the revenue part, which is in FY26, which is 85% of our, this 15% is solution and product, which will move to 60% in 3 years.

red_flags.label: Two large SDV programs ramping down
red_flags.quote: Two of our largest SDV programs coming to an end, but the revenue will be largely compensated by growth in newly acquired accounts.

red_flags.label: Program cancellations at OEMs

red_flags.quote: this is a big drop for us for the first half of the year, and that will be a significant part for us

evasions.topic: Quantum of gap in FY27 revenue from new accounts
